targets.rawSql: SELECT llm_provider_used as value FROM tickets WHERE llm_provider_used IS NOT NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM tickets WHERE auto_resolved = true AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM agent_decisions WHERE fallback_used = true AND decided_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM tickets WHERE draft_response IS NOT NULL AND auto_resolved = false AND triage_routing = 'standard_queue' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

SELECT ticket_id, created_at, category, COALESCE(triage_routing, 'pending') as routing, llm_provider_used as llm, CASE WHEN auto_resolved THEN '✓ auto-resolved' ELSE '' END as status, LEFT(triage_reasoning, 80) as reasoning FROM tickets WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT date_trunc('hour', decided_at) as time, llm_provider as provider, COUNT(*) as decisions FROM agent_decisions WHERE decided_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', decided_at) as time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fallback_used = true) as fallbacks, COUNT(*) as total FROM agent_decisions WHERE decided_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
